plugins.name: build-saas
plugins.description: Build and launch a SaaS app: set up login, database, payments, email, file storage and analytics, secure the API, add legal pages, test, deploy, and launch.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Ship and maintain software: make architecture and tech decisions, debug and fix code safely, review and refactor code, test well, deploy and handle incidents, and keep docs and changelogs current.

plugins.name: find-saas
plugins.description: Find problem gaps worth solving: mine Reddit and reviews for real pain, check search demand, and confirm people already pay for solutions.

plugins.name: cv
plugins.description: Land a job: research the company and role, tailor resumes and cover letters to each application, answer selection criteria and forms, polish LinkedIn and portfolios, prep for interviews and negotiate salary.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Write marketing that gets remembered and converts: clarify positioning, craft messaging and landing copy, pick acquisition channels, improve SEO, and script videos.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Turn ideas into shipped product: scope a project, gather requirements, write PRDs and specs, plan work into tickets, log decisions, and triage incoming requests.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: General thinking and productivity help: brainstorm, research a topic, make a plan, stress-test an idea, summarize long material, hand off work between sessions, and build new Claude skills.

plugins.name: startup
plugins.description: Figure out a startup's strategy: validate the problem with customers, choose a growth channel, set pricing and business model, find traction, and diagnose why growth is stalling.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: Design user experiences: generate and refine solution ideas, plan prototypes, critique interfaces, and turn design challenges into concepts and visual designs.

plugins.name: ux-research
plugins.description: Understand users before building: plan and run research (interviews, surveys, usability tests), recruit participants, synthesize findings into personas, journeys and insights, and share recommendations.
